---
name: Public-interest project proposal
about: Propose or report a concrete Humanity Loop action
title: "[PROJECT] "
labels: ["project-proposal"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What concrete human or institutional problem are you targeting?

## Why it matters

Who could benefit, at what scale, and through what mechanism?

## Existing solutions checked

What mature tools, organizations, standards, datasets, or projects already address this?

## Missing layer

Why is this proposal nonredundant?

## Proposed action

What can actually be executed with available capabilities?

## Evidence

Link primary or authoritative sources.

## Reversibility / risk

What could go wrong? How can the action be undone or contained?

## Success condition

What would count as a meaningful output or outcome?

## Stop condition

When should this project be abandoned, retired, or pivoted?
